title: Two Sum
inputFormat:
Line 1: integer n, the number of elements.
Line 2: n space-separated integers, the array nums.
Line 3: integer target.
outputFormat: Two space-separated indices i and j (i < j) such that nums[i] + nums[j] == target.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 10^4
-10^9 <= nums[i] <= 10^9
-10^9 <= target <= 10^9
Exactly one valid answer exists.
